views.name: hull_rig
findings: The preserved three-mast arrangement, layered square canvas and small aft sail remain distinct, with visible shrouds, ratlines and running lines between the spars and deck.
Longitudinal hull grain, the compact single battery, outboard rig fittings and populated aft working deck are readable in the intact whole-GLB view.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: At the matched 4.5 m field, separate staggered planks show fine grain and seams; worn iron barrels, trunnions, timber carriages and tackle read as distinct material/geometry layers.
The actual open hatch has a deep timber coaming, individual stair treads and handrails. The adjacent capstan has visible whelps, pawl rim, bars and messenger rope.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact hold shows longitudinal plank grain, curved ribs, bilge stringers, overhead beams/knees and a framed mast step rather than the old reference's broad flat room surfaces.
Fitted planked stores and a framed glass lantern remain visible beside the actual mast and hatch stair. Auxiliary lighting reveals the near construction while the far hold keeps natural depth.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The explicitly declared hull/deck cutaway exposes the repeated ribs, longitudinal inner structure, real hatch stair, mast structure and fitted store groups along the hold.
This bright wide structural view is supplementary; fine material grain is assessed in the intact hold/deck close-ups. The delivered GLB is unchanged and every hidden node is listed in the manifest.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin resolves grain on the table boards, wall planking, overhead beams/knees and the mast partner housed in the sole. Paper navigation marks and a small brass instrument add working detail to the table.
The real forward doorway opens onto individual companion treads and the outside deck; the mast, furniture and surrounding timber remain present under the disclosed auxiliary lighting.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: The declared cutaway exposes the actual timber-framed berth with bedding, chart table and planked locker around the mast, making the compact accommodation arrangement inspectable.
Retained curved frames, inner stringers and sole edges show how the furnishing fits within the existing hull. Exterior hull/upper-deck visibility is changed only for this supplementary image.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.
